description: Fetch a single template (library or caller-owned) by ID, including its full DSL source and sampleData. Mirrors GET /api/v1/templates/:id.

templateId.description: Template ID — slug for library rows (e.g. 'invoice-classic') or UUID for user rows.

name: get_template

createdAt.description: When the template was created, as a UTC 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' timestamp.

description.description: One-sentence summary; empty when none is stored.

ownerUserId.description: Owner's user ID, or null for a curated library template.

sampleData.description: Sample binding data stored with the template, or null. render_template without `data` uses the DSL's own `const sampleData`, not this.

templateId.description: Template ID: a slug for library templates, a UUID for your own.

updatedAt.description: When the template was last changed, as a UTC 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' timestamp.

title: Get template
